props.title: 神農本草經

props.title: 本草綱目
props.quote: 甘草，味甘，氣平，無毒。生用則瀉火，熟用則補氣。凡用甘草，須去蘆頭，用蜜炙。甘草為諸藥之君，能和諸藥，解百藥毒。附子，味辛甘，大熱，有大毒。生用則峻，熟用則緩。

props.title: 抱朴子
props.quote: 丹砂燒之成水銀，積變又還成丹砂。黃金入火，百鍊不消。服金者壽如金，服玉者壽如玉。雄黃燒之，其色如金。曾青塗鐵，鐵赤色如銅。

props.modern: roast / steam treatment (often with 甘草 or 黑豆)
props.mechanism: Prolonged heating hydrolyses ester bonds. In Aconitum the C8-acetyl and C14-benzoyl esters of aconitine/mesaconitine/hypaconitine are cleaved to monoesters (benzoylaconine) and then lipo-alkaloids, which are far less potent at voltage-gated Na+ channels.

props.mechanism: Removes surface mucilage, calcium-oxalate raphides and irritant lectins (Pinellia); a physical purification, not a chemical detox.

props.mechanism: Volatile solids (sal ammoniac, calomel, sulphur) vaporise and re-condense. In mercury pharmacy this concentrates the toxic species.

props.mechanism: Volatilisation and partial thermal decomposition; enzyme inactivation; short dry-fry does NOT hydrolyse diterpene diesters — a testable limitation.

props.mechanism: Mild heat absorption and partial volatilisation; mostly a dose/irritancy control.

props.mechanism: Slow-release sugar matrix; masks irritancy.
